UFC Fight Night: Medić vs. Rodriguez is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that will take place on November 8, 2026.

Background[edit]

A welterweight bout between Uroš Medić and Daniel Rodriguez is expected to headline the event.

Announced bouts[edit]

  • Welterweight bout: Uroš Medić vs. Daniel Rodriguez
  • UFC Featherweight Championship bout: Alexander Volkanovski (c) vs. Diego Lopes[3]
  • Middleweight bout: Brad Tavares vs. Marc-André Barriault
  • Bantamweight bout: Farid Basharat vs. Ethyn Ewing
  • Lightweight bout: Mateusz Gamrot vs. TBD
